body:
Track 9 (`osrobot`), milestone 1. Stdlib-only model comparing an XY gantry with an equal-link planar arm over a square work area on cost per good pick per hour.

- At 2 mm tolerance the arm wins only between 0.36 and 0.99 m of work area; tolerance below 1 mm removes its band.
- The result depends heavily on the assumed cost coefficients. Every figure is marked ASSUMED and sensitivity is reported. No real prices were used.
- 10 tests pass, `python3 site/build.py` prints `ok`, and the new `osrobot` theme is added to `projects.json`, the README and the template colours.
- `site/template.html` is a hand-ported file, so the next mirror sync into oss-monorepo must port the two colour tokens and run `mirror.py ack`.
